Hello

I confirm the bug, here are few tests :

![activecheckbox_tests](https://f.cloud.github.com/assets/4560725/1910805/157f35a4-7d20-11e3-9e18-f0db6a4da9d0.jpg)

When attribute value is equal to uncheck value (when provided), checkbox should be unchecked.

PS: And in my opinion, when value is provided, checkbox should be checked only when attribute value is the same.
Right. Want to fix it yourself?

Ok ^^
But before, do you agree with my PS ?

Value should be checked when attribute value is the same as `value`, i.e. `Y` and unchecked otherwise.

Ideally there should be validator complaining about values other than `Y` or `N` but if there there isn't, it's better to be safe than sorry.

repository.name: yii2-widget-switchinput
repository.description: A Yii2 wrapper widget for the Bootstrap Switch plugin to use checkboxes & radios as toggle switches (sub repo split from yii2-widgets)

issue.body:
Try the following:

```
echo SwitchInput::widget([
    'name' => 'mycheckbox',
    'value' => 6,
    'options' => [
        'checked' => FALSE,
    ],
    'pluginOptions' => [
        'onText' => 'Yes',
        'offText' => 'No',
    ]
]);
```

The checkbox is always checked. This is partly yii2 core's fault. See https://github.com/yiisoft/yii2/issues/1959. The fix for that issue is inside `activeCheckbox()`, but doesn't apply to `checkbox()`. Since SwitchInput uses `checkbox()`, if there is a value set, the checkbox will always be marked as checked.

Can we perhaps allow SwitchInput to take a model as input or uncheck the checkbox if `checked` is set to `FALSE`?
